@jlevy, thank you for the careful import and the clear account of what was and was not checked.

**Licence.** I dedicate both bundles, `squares-exact-forms.zip` and `t244-exact-configurations.zip`, including the data files and the code, to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Please keep the files themselves.

**Method credit.** Agreed: crediting the values and not a method is right, since Daniel's `exactsolve.py` already does the KKT-plus-integer-relation step.

**Second order.** For what it is worth, not as a claim: at double precision I computed the Hessian of the Lagrangian on the tangent space of the active contacts. Its least eigenvalue is −2.3·10⁻¹⁷ at 172 and −7.1·10⁻¹⁹ at 263, on flex spaces of dimension 10. That is zero to rounding, with no negative curvature. It is not certified, and semidefiniteness alone does not prove a local minimum, so recording no local minimality is right.

**297.** Yes. The KKT system on the record's active contacts (4,133 equations; input T-174's witness, atlas `best-297.json` at `659ee62`) closes. Two solves from perturbed starts agree to all 1,500 digits, so the stationary side is pinned:

s* = 17.740417287543801850975801594884289593640654923446195273425…

This lies 3.36·10⁻⁹⁰ below #574's certificate, i.e. the verified bound `E-pingyou-574-exact-feasibility`, so also below Daniel's degree-12 form. I have not identified it: LLL at 1,500 digits finds no integer relation of degree ≤ 40 or ≤ 70. At those degrees, a relation with coefficients below about 10³⁰ (degree 40) or 10²⁰ (degree 70) is excluded. So its degree is presumably higher than at 172 and 263. No exact configuration exists at 297.

**297: the stationary side is algebraic of degree 21, with an exact configuration. This corrects my previous comment.**

**Correction.** My previous comment said LLL at 1,500 digits finds "no integer relation of degree ≤ 40 or ≤ 70" at 297. That is wrong. The search did find a relation: the residual was 10⁻¹⁴⁷⁰, where a chance vector at those settings gives about 10⁻¹³⁹⁰. My acceptance test rejected it because LLL returned a degree-40 multiple of the true polynomial, whose height looked too large. I rechecked the other negative results listed in this issue. Their residuals are all at the chance level, so they stand.

**Claim.** At 297, the stationary side of T-174's record packing (#574) is the only real root of an irreducible degree-21 integer polynomial P₂₉₇ (coefficient height 32 digits):

s(297) ≤ S\* = 17.740417287543801850975801594884289593640654923446195273425233561350268049817798181605818039609627693…

This is 3.36·10⁻⁹⁰ below #574's certificate, so it is also below Daniel's degree-12 form there.

P₂₉₇, from the highest degree down:
`[5132808, -1586095344, 228598684740, -20404120309236, 1262626027878614, -57436262834549232, 1986068651966039493, -53203379929668937537, 1114026148043113588981, -18247982793999621262225, 232443910249786816547759, -2284565165760889750853523, 17600615303471423775941661, -122166140066389399013579571, 1070886436867725526768330264, -12023949461854699430498292728, 120430271873674900318538825508, -895489685309431631543377527736, 4666788670130135449881930998396, -16205039054269168587855530573516, 33866821896121801728448715010976, -32376606286941230041635986781104]`

**Certificate.** The attached `s297-exact-configuration.zip` (SHA-256 `e08b5d0a64c5c68eed827ee7e323687929048a4cfea438bb77ef390bdd4147a7`) contains `n297.minpoly.json` (SHA-256 `e5c340b8af2ff75d01b9b414e32ef19d9c3d07ecce665c8fddad9c5952252826`) in Daniel's `minpoly.json` format.
[s297-exact-configuration.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33925868/s297-exact-configuration.zip)

- Every centre and half-angle tangent lies in K = Q(t), where t is the half-angle tangent of the 44.74° band.
- K has degree 21 and f has height 300667.
- S\* ∈ K.
- The configuration equals the record within 1.6·10⁻¹⁴ (centres) and 7.1·10⁻¹⁴° (angles).

It was built exactly as at 172 and 263, with 19 free coordinates pinned to the record's binary64 values. Five near-45° squares whose angles are free were snapped to their classes, with drift ≤ 6·10⁻¹⁷.

**Checking.**
- `verify_exact.py` (unchanged, evand/square-packing at `659ee62`): `VALID … field degree 21; 1750 touching incidences proved as identities in K, 7138 strict by intervals, 42922 pairs by discs`.
- `check_field_packing.py`: VALID, with 615 contacts exact in K and 1204 strict by Arb balls.
- The controls reject the same mutations as at 172 and 263, including a band square turned by about 10⁻³⁰.
- P₂₉₇ is irreducible (SymPy). Its only real root agrees with the 3000-digit KKT side to 100 digits.

**Licence.** CC0 1.0, as for the other two bundles.

**AI assistance.** As before: the computation, the construction and the checks were done by Claude (Anthropic, model Claude Opus 5.5) at my direction, and I reviewed and reran them.
